Authors: Patel, L.; Sharma, Y.; Park, K.; Liu, F.; Liu, K.
Title: Nitrogen and sulfur co-doped multi-walled carbon nanotubes with edge sites for thermal management (series 0)
Abstract: Nitrogen and sulfur co-doped multi-walled carbon nanotubes were investigated. Samples were grown by chemical vapor deposition and characterised by XPS and Raman spectroscopy. Armchair edge and zigzag edge sites dominate the response. We evaluate the thermal conductivity and phonon transport.

Title: Undoped carbon nanotube yarns under ion irradiation for lithium-ion batteries (series 2)

Title: Undoped carbon nanotube sponges containing monovacancies for thermal management (series 4)
